info.title: Tollkit Web
info.description: Web search with date, site and news filters; read one page or five at once, screenshot and summarize them in a real browser; and read PDFs as text. Other Tollkit tools are described at: https://extract.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://attest.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://chain.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://data.tollkit.dev/openapi.json.
info.x-guidance: Call any operation with POST and the JSON body its schema shows. Without payment you get HTTP 402 with the exact price in USDC on Base or Solana; pay with any x402 client and repeat the request. Failed calls (any 4xx or 5xx) are never charged. Each operation's description says what it returns and which inputs are refused for free.

post.summary: Read any web page as clean text
post.description: Read any web page as clean text, rendered in a real browser so JavaScript pages work: visible text (up to 50,000 characters), title and final URL. $0.002 per page; a page that fails to load or is empty is not charged.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public page. JavaScript pages are rendered first.

final_url.description: Where the browser ended up after redirects.

text.description: The page's visible text, rendered in a real browser, navigation and boilerplate stripped.

truncated.description: True when the page went on past the 50,000-character cap.

post.description: Web search: give a query, get Google's top results (title, URL, snippet, date) plus the direct answer box and knowledge panel when there is one, as clean JSON. Filter by date (past hour, day, week, month or year), keep to or leave out up to 5 sites each, or search news only. Up to 10 results, optional country. $0.003 per search; a search with no results is not charged. To read the pages too, use /search/read.

country.description: Two-letter country code for localised results, e.g. "us".

freshness.description: Only results from the past hour, day, week, month or year.

include_domains.description: Only results from these sites, e.g. ["reuters.com", "sec.gov"]. Subdomains count.

type.description: "news" searches news articles (with publisher and date) instead of the whole web.

answer.description: Google's direct answer box, when there is one.

filters.description: The filters that were applied: freshness, include_domains, exclude_domains, type.

post.description: Search the web and read the top results in one call: give a query, get the top web results and the full visible text of the top 1-3 pages, each rendered in a real browser (JavaScript pages work). Unreadable results are skipped for the next one down. Takes the same date, site and news filters as /search. For research, RAG and answering questions from fresh sources. $0.005 per call; nothing is charged if no page can be read.

include_domains.description: Only results from these sites, e.g. ["reuters.com", "sec.gov"]. Subdomains count.

type.description: "news" searches news articles (with publisher and date) instead of the whole web.

page.description: The page read in a real browser: final_url, title, text (up to 12,000 chars), text_length, truncated, fetched_at. Null when it couldn't be read.

filters.description: The filters that were applied: freshness, include_domains, exclude_domains, type.
